verdicts.reason: A is just the original scaled and centred, which leaves wide dead white columns on both sides, so it looks pillarboxed rather than redesigned for the wide banner format. It is still coherent and close to the original. B is broken: the barrel photo is shoved to the left and ends abruptly at x≈415, while the watercolour wash runs further right and then stops with a hard edge at x≈595. The logo, title and tagline sit off-centre (about x≈298 on a 768-wide canvas), and the right ~170px is empty, so the layout is lopsided.
